propositions: Extraction from free-text JSON is heuristic and can be won by trailing schema-valid decoys or fence-wrapped quoted material, requiring an explicit output channel to make payload location a stated contract.

parse_structured must be refactored to extract marker-bounded blocks in reverse document order, returning the first block whose content validates, with all blocks failing closed if markers are present but no block validates.
Marker lines must be line-anchored (recognized only when alone on a physical line after whitespace stripping) to prevent collision with JSON string values containing the literal marker text.
The bounded-retry prompt in structured_run.py must name the same markers as the first attempt to ensure the fail-closed retry channel is consistent with the initial directive.

A reply with no complete marker blocks must fall through to schema-filtered full-reply selection with byte-for-byte identical results to today's behavior, preserving backward compatibility with markerless and legacy transcripts.

The single-sourced SENTINEL_DIRECTIVE constant must appear in schema_directive output, the marker extraction logic, and the retry instruction to eliminate drift between what the model is instructed and what the parser recognizes.
